query:
INSERT INTO folders (id, parent_id, name, path, created_at, updated_at)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
                    ON CONFLICT(path) DO UPDATE SET 
                        parent_id = COALESCE(excluded.parent_id, folders.parent_id),
                        updated_at = excluded.updated_at
                    RETURNING id as "id!"
